# h3_database_user (Resource)

Manages a user (login role) of an `h3_database` (PostgreSQL or MariaDB). `connection_limit`, `grants`, `system_roles` and `settings` change in place without a restart; `name` and `database_id` force a new user. Users never get superuser, createdb, createrole or replication. A read replica (`h3_database` with `replica_of`) has the users of its source: `database_id` of a replica is a plan-time error `REPLICA_READ_ONLY`, create the user on the source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "h3_database_user" "checkout" {
  database_id = h3_database.pg.id
  name        = "s_checkout"

  # -1 = unlimited (default), 1..5000. Changed in place, no restart.
  connection_limit = 50

  grants = [
    { database = "app", preset = "readwrite" },
  ]
}

# PostgreSQL monitoring user for an exporter: CONNECT only + pg_monitor,
# with a statement timeout for its own sessions.
resource "h3_database_user" "exporter" {
  database_id = h3_database.pg.id
  name        = "s_pg_exporter"

  grants = [
    { database = "app", preset = "monitor" },
  ]

  # Built-in roles; not set = not managed. GRANT/REVOKE online.
  system_roles = ["pg_monitor"]

  # Defaults of new sessions (ALTER ROLE ... SET). Write values as the API
  # returns them: 30s, 5min, 64MB; 0 = no limit.
  settings = {
    statement_timeout             = "30s"
    lock_timeout                  = "5s"
    default_transaction_isolation = "read committed"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `database_id` (String) ID of the `h3_database`
- `name` (String) User name: 1-63 of `a-z`, `0-9`, `_`, starting with a letter or `_`; not reserved (`postgres`, `app`, `root`, `pg_*`, ...)

### Optional

- `connection_limit` (Number) Maximum concurrent connections of the user: `-1` (default) = unlimited, or 1-5000. Changed in place **without a restart**; sessions already open stay. PostgreSQL: CNPG applies `ALTER ROLE ... CONNECTION LIMIT`; MariaDB: `MAX_USER_CONNECTIONS`.
- `grants` (Attributes Set) Access presets per database inside the cluster. Replaces all access of the user on change. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--grants))
- `settings` (Map of String) PostgreSQL only. Defaults of the user's new sessions (`ALTER ROLE ... SET`): `default_transaction_isolation` (`read committed`, `repeatable read`, `serializable`), `statement_timeout`, `lock_timeout`, `idle_in_transaction_session_timeout` (0..`24h`), `idle_session_timeout` (0..`7d`), `work_mem` (`64kB`..1/8 of the database RAM, at most `2GB`). Write values the way the API returns them: `30s`, `5min`, `1500ms`, `64MB`; `0` = no limit. Replaces the whole set on change (`{}` resets all). Not set = not managed.
- `system_roles` (Set of String) PostgreSQL only. Built-in roles the user is a member of: `pg_monitor`, `pg_read_all_stats`, `pg_read_all_settings`, `pg_stat_scan_tables`, `pg_signal_backend`, `pg_read_all_data` (the current list is `systemRoles` of `GET /api/databases/v1/{id}/limits`). Replaces the set on change (`[]` removes all); GRANT/REVOKE online, no restart. Not set = not managed: roles given in the console stay.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<database_id>/<name>`
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Generated password
- `status` (String) `READY`, `PENDING` or `ERROR`

<a id="nestedatt--grants"></a>
### Nested Schema for `grants`

Required:

- `database` (String) Database name inside the cluster
- `preset` (String) `owner`, `readwrite`, `readonly` or `monitor` (PostgreSQL: CONNECT only, for a monitoring user with `pg_monitor`)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by <database_id>/<name>
terraform import h3_database_user.checkout 11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555/s_checkout
```
